overview_markdown:
## Overview

n8nClaw is a lightweight, self-hosted AI assistant implemented entirely as an [n8n](https://n8n.io) workflow, explicitly inspired by OpenClaw. Rather than shipping a custom runtime, it composes n8n trigger nodes (Telegram, WhatsApp via Evolution API webhook, Gmail polling, and an hourly heartbeat) into a single visual pipeline that normalizes incoming messages, resolves user profiles, and routes them to a central agent.

The core agent runs Claude Sonnet 4.5 via OpenRouter with a 15-message Postgres chat memory window and a configurable 'soul' personality field. A switch node routes replies back to the originating channel, while a set of sub-agents and tools — task/subtask databases, research, email and document managers, and tiered worker agents — handle autonomous work. A scheduled memory pipeline aggregates chat history, summarizes it with Haiku 4.5, embeds it via OpenAI, and stores it in a Supabase vector store for long-term RAG.

Compared to OpenClaw, n8nClaw trades a dedicated, hardened agent runtime for the accessibility of low-code orchestration: everything is inspectable and editable in n8n's visual editor. The trade-offs are significant — it depends on multiple external SaaS services (OpenRouter, OpenAI, Supabase, Evolution API), has no sandboxing story, and is a very young project with only initial commits, no releases, and no measurable community discussion yet.
